projectDescription: A fast Rust MCP server and CLI that converts any file — PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, EPUB, HTML, images (OCR), and audio/video — into clean Markdown for AI agents, running fully locally with no API key.
keyFeatures: Converts PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, EPUB, HTML, images, audio, and video to clean Markdown in a single call
Four MCP tools: read, outline, search, and inspect — compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, and more
Native Rust parallel processing — 212× faster than docling on benchmarks, no external models required
Local-first and private: no API key, no cloud upload, documents never leave the machine
Layout engine reconstructs reading order from glyph positions, recovers borderless tables, and handles two-column papers
Token-lean output: page anchors, front-matter headers, compact tables, and a cursor for pagination within an agent's context window
OCR via local doc-VLM (PaddleOCR-VL) or tesseract; audio/video transcripts via bundled Qwen3-ASR
Python API with LangChain and LlamaIndex loaders; installable via npm, pip, cargo, or Docker
anymd Pro adds verifiable video timelines with hashed frames and offline cite-check for PDF quote verification
publicApiSurface: MCP tool: read — converts a file, URL, or directory to Markdown
MCP tool: outline — returns the document heading tree with node IDs and byte ranges
MCP tool: search — finds text across files, folders, and URLs with BM25 fallback
MCP tool: inspect — render_page, extract_regions, ocr_pages, structure, compare, cite_check (Pro)
CLI: anymd <file|url|dir> — convert to Markdown on stdout
CLI: anymd outline <file|url> -- show document tree
CLI: anymd search <query> [paths] — search across files and directories
CLI: anymd setup [--dry-run] [--remove] — configure MCP clients
CLI: anymd setup ocr — download doc-VLM OCR engine and weights
CLI: anymd doctor — show version and available optional tools
CLI: anymd mcp — run MCP server on stdio
Environment: ANYMD_CACHE_DIR, ANYMD_OCR, ANYMD_BIN, MCP_PDF_ALLOWED_DIRS, MCP_TRANSPORT, MCP_API_KEY
